messages.subject: CFA anova: Error in lav_func_jacobian_complex
parts:
Dear All,

I am comparing two CFA models with categorical DV's, of the following form:

2factormodel <- 'f1a =~ item1 + item2 + item3
                        f1b =~ item4 + item5 + item6
                        f2 =~ item7 + item8 + item9

                        f1a ~~ 1 * f1b
                        f1a ~~ f2
                        f1b ~~ equal("f1a~~f2") * f2'

3factormodel <- 'f1a =~ item1 + item2 + item3
                        f1b =~ item4 + item5 + item6
                        f2 =~ item7 + item8 + item9'

When comparing the model fits using the anova function, I receive the following error:

Error in lav_func_jacobian_complex(func = af, x = m1@Fit@x) : 
  function does not support non-numeric (complex) argument

I found this odd, since I subsequently compared the models using MPlus (with the DIFFTEST function), and this did provide me with sensible output.

Does anyone know why this occurs in Lavaan?

Thanks!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: CFA anova: Error in lav_func_jacobian_complex
parts:
Error in lav_func_jacobian_complex(func = af, x = m1@Fit@x) : 
  function does not support non-numeric (complex) argument

This might have something to do with the crazy math need to calculate chi-squared difference tests with ordered outcomes, combined with using a nonlinear equality constraint.  Instead of using the equal()* operator, try simply giving the 2 correlations the same label.

2factormodel <- 'f1a =~ item1 + item2 + item3
                 f1b =~ item4 + item5 + item6
                 f2 =~ item7 + item8 + item9

                 f1a ~~ 1*f1b

f1a ~~ Cov1*f2
                 f1b ~~ Cov1*f2 '

I think this method handles the equality constraint in a simpler way.  Compare Approaches 1 and 2 (I think using the equal()* operator is the equivalent of Approach 2): http://lavaan.ugent.be/notes/lavaan_eq_constraints.pdf

So using labels might work... worth a try.

Terry
